dedupe_keys.name: cobrapro battery model and parameter optimizer

description: COBRAPRO is a MATLAB toolbox for physics-based lithium-ion battery modelling and parameter identification. It implements a Doyle-Fuller-Newman, or pseudo-two-dimensional, cell model with conservation and reaction equations. Users fit parameters against measured current-voltage behaviour and compare simulated voltage and state of charge. Its spatial coverage is a user-specified battery cell, not a grid, and its temporal coverage is the test or duty-cycle period supplied. The public repository states an MIT licence. Calibrated cell responses can provide inputs to storage or electric-vehicle simulations that test charging, degradation or capacity assumptions. A caveat is that a fitted cell model does not represent a whole battery pack or the controls and temperature conditions of an installation. MATLAB is a required commercial runtime, which may limit use even though the toolbox licence is open. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was found. The article and repository were read; the toolbox and MATLAB were not run.
